# Pulse Social

> Creator-first social platform on Solana. Fans buy Supporter Shares to unlock exclusive content; creators earn via direct SOL tips and on-chain supporter pools — no platform middleman.

Pulse Social v1.1 (MVP) ships one product loop: **fans buy Supporter Shares → unlock supporters-only posts → creators earn on-chain**. The live deployment runs on Solana Devnet. Post metadata and media use Pinata IPFS; access to gated content is verified on-chain via share holdings.

Key terms:
- **Supporter Shares**: on-chain pool fans buy into to support a creator; holdings gate exclusive posts.
- **accessLevel**: post metadata field — `public` or `supporters`.
- **MVP scope**: marketplace, governance, groups, and subscription tiers are deferred (UI hidden); focus is Supporter Shares.

## Product

- [What is Pulse Social](https://pulsesol.xyz/what.md): Platform overview, core features, and how Supporter Shares work for fans and creators.
- [Why Pulse Social](https://pulsesol.xyz/why.md): Problems with Web2 social platforms and why on-chain creator support matters.
- [User Guide](https://pulsesol.xyz/guide.md): Step-by-step onboarding — wallet, profile, pool, posts, and supporter access.
- [Whitepaper](https://pulsesol.xyz/whitepaper.md): Full MVP protocol and product architecture in LLM-readable Markdown.

## Platform

- [Home](https://pulsesol.xyz/): Landing page and primary value proposition.
- [Feed](https://pulsesol.xyz/feed): Social feed with public and supporter-gated posts.
- [Explore](https://pulsesol.xyz/explore): Discover creators and trending content.
- [Creator Dashboard](https://pulsesol.xyz/dashboard): Launch Supporter Shares pool, manage posts, and view supporter stats.
